notes: Initial discovery 2025-11: building CX automation layer for 24/7 chat; currently route 480k monthly messages through hybrid bot->agent flow.
Primary ask: aggressive cost targets for chat deflection. Goal: <$0.03 per successfully deflected chat (includes prompts, caching, infra amortization).
Latency SLO for agent-assist snippets: <200ms tail (p95) — must be near real-time for agents in web UI.
Spikes: product launches / major incident windows see 8-12x concurrent traffic bursts for 1-6 hours. Need graceful degradation and routing policies.
Preference: quantized model variants for deflection path; fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained. Interested in automatic batching + prefix caching to reduce unit cost.
Security: EU data residency for EU customers; SSO (SAML) required; audit logs for assistant actions; retention controls for transcripts.
Integrations: Zendesk + Genesys + internal ticketing. Want tool-calling support for ticket creation and macro invocation.
Quote from Dir. of Automation: 'We can only roll this if the unit economics work - saving agent seats is great but costs per deflection must be predictable.'
Current vendor experiments: using open-source quantized LLMs on prem for peak traffic but cost + ops overhead high; exploring Redwood for unified runtime + dedicated pools.
AE notes: interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batch sizes, cache TTL) to model monthly cost sensitivity.
